pages.title: LoL New Dawn: Confirmed News & 2027 Update Guide
pages.description: A source-led guide to League of Legends New Dawn. Separate Riot announcements from rumors, follow the reveal timeline and check release status.
pages.heading: League of Legends New Dawn
pages.lead: A new era. A clearer picture.
pages.intro: Follow New Dawn without losing the thread. Start with the announcements, check what remains unknown, and trace each update back to its source.

sections.label: 01 / ON THE RECORD
sections.heading: What is confirmed?
sections.text: New Dawn appears in Riot’s official League of Legends announcements for 2027. Riot has also opened a dedicated page for future updates.

sections.label: 02 / READ WITH CARE
sections.heading: What is still unconfirmed?
sections.text: An exact launch day, regional rollout times and a public testing schedule are not established by the official pages checked here. Do not turn a predicted month into a release date.

sections.label: 04 / SAME WORDS, DIFFERENT CONTEXT
sections.heading: New Dawn vs. A New Dawn
sections.text: Looking for the cinematic? A New Dawn is the earlier League film, documented in 2014 coverage. That film’s champions and scenes are not evidence of features in the 2027 update.

faq.question: Where should I follow official updates?
faq.answer: Use Riot’s New Dawn hub and League news. This site links back to those sources and does not collect email addresses.

faq.question: Is every detail in a leak confirmed?
faq.answer: No. A rumor needs its own source and a clear unconfirmed label. We will not fill a guide with unsupported feature lists.

pages.title: LoL New Dawn Release Date: 2027 Window & January Reveal
pages.description: LoL New Dawn is planned for later in 2027, with a full reveal in January 2027. Check confirmed timing, unknown dates and the source timeline.
pages.heading: LoL New Dawn release date
pages.intro: The exact release date has not been announced in the official sources checked on November 16, 2026. Keep the reveal and launch as two separate milestones.

sections.label: 01 / THE SHORT ANSWER
sections.heading: When does New Dawn come out?
sections.text: Riot’s announcement points to release later in 2027. It does not name a month or day. A precise countdown would imply more certainty than the announcement provides.

sections.label: 02 / REVEAL ≠ RELEASE
sections.heading: What happens in January 2027?
sections.text: January is the full reveal milestone. It is not a confirmed January launch. The year follows the November 2026 announcement’s reference to the upcoming January.

sections.label: 04 / WHAT TO WATCH NEXT
sections.heading: How this page will change
sections.text: Look for an explicit release announcement, any testing details and region-specific timing. When a source adds or changes one of those facts, we will update this page and its modification date.

faq.question: Can I download New Dawn now?
faq.answer: The sources checked here do not provide a separate New Dawn download. Use official Riot channels rather than third-party installers promising early access.

faq.question: Is there a confirmed beta date?
faq.answer: No beta date is established by the official pages reviewed for this guide. We will add one only when a source supplies it.

faq.question: Does a January reveal mean a January release?
faq.answer: No. The full reveal and the planned release later in 2027 are separate milestones.
